column1: # helpers/known-flakes.tsv: the CI failures that are known flakes, one per line. Read by
# helpers/arm.sh, which arms a pull request ejected for `failed_checks` at its current head only when
# a failed merge-group job's log matches one of these. Provisional name.
# Three tab-separated fields: a short name, an extended regular expression (grep -E) matched
# against the output of `gh run view <run> --log-failed`, and the note that records the flake, its
# measurement and why a rerun cures it. A line whose record does not exist fails
# Add a line only for a failure a note shows to be a flake, and remove it when the fix lands. A
